name: planguides-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for `planGuides` (pro tier, PARITY-PLAN-GUIDES): the 2D plan editor's persistent ruler-guide buttons ('+ V guide' / '+ H guide' / 'Clear guides') in the Plan menu. Simple: menu has no guide controls at all. Pro: a real pointermove over the plan SVG sets the cursor's plan-coordinate, then '+ V guide' and '+ H guide' pin axis-aligned guides at that (snapped) coordinate — asserted via `floorPlan.guides`, rendered visibly by `PlanGuidesLayer`, then cleared via 'Clear guides' and re-verified hidden back in Simple.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); })()

steps.name: assert-flag-off-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.planGuides; if (f !== false) throw new Error('planGuides should resolve false in Simple mode, got ' + f); })()

steps.name: open-plan-menu-simple
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')) return; const b = find(); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu did not open'); })()

steps.name: assert-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (!panel) throw new Error('Plan menu panel missing'); const t = panel.textContent||''; if (t.includes('V guide') || t.includes('H guide') || t.includes('Clear guides')) throw new Error('guide controls visible in Simple mode — planGuides is pro-tier and should be hidden'); })()

steps.name: close-plan-menu
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 3000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (!document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')) return; const b = find(); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu did not close'); })()

steps.name: reresolve-flags
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().reresolveFeatureFlags()

steps.name: assert-flag-on-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.planGuides; if (f !== true) throw new Error('planGuides should resolve true in Pro mode, got ' + f); })()

steps.name: hover-plan-canvas
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg'); if (!svg) throw new Error('plan svg not found'); const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = r.left + r.width * 0.55; const y = r.top + r.height * 0.45; svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, pointerId: 11, pointerType: 'mouse', isPrimary: true, clientX: x, clientY: y })); })()

steps.name: open-plan-menu-pro
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel && (panel.textContent||'').includes('V guide')) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu (Pro) did not show guide controls'); })()

steps.name: click-v-guide
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); const btn = panel && [...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === '+ V guide'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'+ V guide' button not found in Pro menu"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: reopen-plan-menu-for-h-guide
steps.comment: PlanMenu.tsx closes the whole menu on ANY click inside .plan-menu-panel (it bubbles to the panel's own onClick) — clicking '+ V guide' above already closed it, so it must be reopened before the next action.
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel && (panel.textContent||'').includes('H guide')) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu did not reopen for H guide'); })()

steps.name: click-h-guide
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); const btn = panel && [...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === '+ H guide'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'+ H guide' button not found in Pro menu"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-guides-finite
steps.eval: (function(){ const gs = window.__store.getState().floorPlan.guides; for (const g of gs) { if (!Number.isFinite(g.pos)) throw new Error('guide pos not finite: ' + JSON.stringify(g)); } })()

steps.name: close-plan-menu-2
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 3000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (!document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')) return; const b = find(); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu did not close'); })()

steps.name: assert-two-guide-lines-drawn
steps.eval: (function(){ const n = document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen svg line[stroke-dasharray]').length; if (n !== 2) throw new Error('expected 2 rendered guide lines (1 V + 1 H), found ' + n); })()
